Creates two identically positioned light-gray spawn-info-line images. The second receives ui_add. Both are added/published in order; the selected body has no spawn decision, callback or explicit close hook. Exact child order: SpawnInfoLine, SpawnInfoLineAdd. All layout/property/asset values and each callback body are retained in the ordered trace. Calls the optional same-file-or-unresolved PostLoadFunc at its exact source position, then returns self; a same name in another file supplies no binding.
